title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Satin Chrome | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add flexible towel storage to your bathroom without wall mounting with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand, crafted from solid brass with a heavy base for stability in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance.

  • Satin Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
  • Stability + floor protection: heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching
  • Coordinated look: part of the Soho collection with multiple designer finish options available

Specs

  • Collection: Soho
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Overall size: 12-Inch L x 9.25-Inch W x 49-Inch H
  • Diameter: 1-Inch
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Product weight: 13.6 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
